basis.ixe: the closure of the Nat, Bool, Eq, PUnit, Empty, False and Quot
blocks, extracted with `ix shard extract` from the bound Init+Std artifact
(sha256 cb961f7219438620505a785e8942a6604b18e871dd00dc0ac15766234153117c).
It carries the compiler's records and names (without metadata, so only
anonymous checks apply) but no role binding; tests bind roles themselves.
